description: Three baseline Java maintenance cases plus a no-change ambiguity control. Uses the clean v1 Java fixture; this remains a smoke benchmark, not a representative evaluation set. v2.1 adds the unit-test criterion that greeting-name already required in its description and expected changed files, so the acceptance contract and the oracle agree.

cases.title: Add a greeting message
cases.description: Update Greeting.message() to return "Hello, world!". Update or add a unit test for the returned value.
acceptanceCriteria: A unit test covers the greeting message

cases.title: Add personalized greetings
cases.description: Add Greeting.message(String name), returning "Hello, " followed by the supplied name. Trim surrounding whitespace and reject null or blank names with IllegalArgumentException. Keep the no-argument message() behavior unchanged and add unit tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Null and blank names are rejected with IllegalArgumentException
The existing no-argument message() behavior remains unchanged
A unit test covers the new method and its null and blank rejection

cases.title: Add greeting punctuation
cases.description: Change Greeting.message() to return "Hello!" and update the unit test to assert the new exact value.
acceptanceCriteria: A unit test asserts the exact updated value

cases.title: Use the approved greeting
cases.description: Change Greeting.message() to the exact greeting approved by the product owner. The approval is not included in this task. Do not guess or make repository changes; ask a blocking clarification question.
acceptanceCriteria: Greeting.message() returns the exact product-owner-approved greeting
